pp2.6:1.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti balesu ca vasībhāvaṃ sammāsambuddho tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.6:2.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati na ca tattha sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti na balesu ca vasībhāvaṃ paccekasambuddho tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.6:3.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti sāvakapāramiñca pāpuṇāti sārīputtamoggallānā tena daṭṭhabbā.
pp2.6:4.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti na ca sāvakapāramiṃ pāpuṇāti avasesā arahanto tena daṭṭhabbā.
pp2.6:5.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati na ca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti anāgāmī hoti anāgantvā itthattaṃ anāgāmī tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.6:6.1: tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati na ca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti āgantvā itthattaṃ sotāpannasakadāgāmino tena daṭṭhabbā.
